b2a.name: Tarn-rim hollow outlet
b2a.note: D4: the 0.39 ha conditioned hollow between the south-east arm and the High Tarn rim gets a natural outlet (no new tarn).

b1.1: B1.1 = the one corrective iteration after the first Three.js review of B1.0: broader face structure (weaker, longer rib field, more smoothing), flank variation along every ridge, clearer summit hierarchy (Tarntind 768, Vesttind 724, Skar notch 690, Western Col opened), wider windward-gully feather.
b2a: B2a.1 = the one bounded corrective pass: the first B2a build (B2a.0) passed the seam limit but lowered the west arm beyond Vesttind by about 80 m (21 px on the Birchwood skyline) because the 520 m arm-west terminal reached inland past the protected Vesttind radius. The arm-west terminal is shortened to 380 m.

b2a.note: D2: B1.1 applied no end caps in its flank-variation branch, so this arm continued as a radial cone behind the summit and filled the Western Col (726 m at N1). The cap now ends it 30 m behind the summit.

b1.1: The R1 peak-ascent is kept unchanged as reference (peak-ascent-r1 in the viewer). The candidate alignment follows R1 to where it enters the edited terrain, then is regenerated on the B1 surface by a grade-constrained search: it climbs the windward Vestfjell plateau, crosses towards the Western Col, and reaches the summit by switchbacks on the south-west shoulder. The target hiking grade is 0.30; a declared summit scramble covers the last 140 m to the top.

b2a.text: B2a: the R1 peak-ascent is followed to where it enters the edited terrain, then a grade- and cross-slope-limited search reaches the Vestfjell shoulder viewpoint (primary hiking approach, hiking grade <= 0.30). From the viewpoint an explicitly optional summit scramble (grade <= 0.50) reaches North Peak. Steep traverses get a modelled trail bench.
b2a.viewpointNote: The viewpoint is the highest node on the south-west shoulder reachable within the primary limits (grade <= 0.30 on rendered triangle edges, side-slope <= 0.9, no cell steeper than 1.25), searched within 200 m of (-636, 2680). It is chosen deterministically by the build.

b2a: D2 reconciliation: B1.1 authored N1 668 m with Vesttind 724 m (56 m prominence). Vesttind came out 735.8 m and is kept (summit hierarchy is protected), so the prominence intent (about 56 m) sets the col to about 680 m. 668 m would make Vesttind 68 m prominent, over-separating the west arm.
